description: AION 2: where gear and growth items come from (The Aetherium Guide, phase 3, 18 Oct 2026). One record per content or reward cycle. Expedition loot is per difficulty (name, slot group, grade, item level), from the AION2 Wiki loot tables; Transcendence Arcana by Stage; the Conquest cube; Sealed Dungeon, Stronghold, Nightmare and Daily Dungeon rewards; and the cycle each runs on. Every record has a status and provenance; anything the sources do not give is pending, never guessed. itemLevel on a drop is the item's own level; entryItemLevel is the character item level a difficulty asks for.

records.label: Which slots a drop fills
records.text: The wiki names drops by series (a weapon series, an armour series, an accessory series, a Guard). The weapon and the Guard are one slot each. Which slots an armour or accessory series covers is not listed, so those are our reading of the series name.

groups.name: Armour
groups.note: The cloak is not named in any Expedition table.

groups.name: Accessory
groups.note: Bracelets are not named in any Expedition table.

unlisted.reason: No source we hold names where these drop yet.

records.label: Weekly reset
records.text: Weekly entry and reward limits reset every Wednesday at 07:00 UTC. Use what is left before then.
records.note: One line of the wiki page says 5:00 AM, which reads as a local server time. The brief for this guide (Miguel, 18 Oct 2026) uses 07:00 UTC.

records.label: Odyle Energy
records.text: Expeditions cost Odyle Energy only when you open the reward cube after the final boss. No energy, no reward: wait for it to refill or use a refill item. Entering and learning the route is free.

refill.reason: How fast Odyle Energy refills is not listed yet.

records.label: Transcendence weekly count
records.text: Transcendence rewards run on a weekly count. Kina is paid in full for the first 55 runs of the week, then less.

records.label: Once per site
records.text: Each Sealed Dungeon and Stronghold pays its completion reward once, then its marker leaves the map. Kina and some items from them, and from field hunting, have a daily limit.

records.label: Nightmare attempts
records.text: Two attempts a day at 07:00 UTC, stacking up to 14. An attempt is used when you clear.

records.label: Ascension Trial entries
records.text: Three entries a week. An entry is used as soon as you go in, even if you fail.

records.label: Daily Dungeon attempts
records.text: Despite the name, the Daily Dungeon gives 14 attempts a week.

records.label: Cube Condensed Energy
records.text: Every Expedition reward you claim adds to your cube count. At the count you get a Cube Condensed Energy item: on Conquest it lets you pick one Unique item. On Exploration it can be claimed only a limited number of times.

records.name: Sealed Dungeons

level.text: Best done at the level cap: their drops scale with your level. The fixed completion reward does not.

records.text: Small solo caves hidden on the map as question marks, about 10 minutes each. Do the rival faction's too, through the Spacetime Rift.

records.name: Strongholds

belt.text: The Noble Belt goes to +10 with its own scrolls, then moves up a grade in Substance Morph: Advanced, then Epic, then Unique. The Unique step needs Strongholds in the rival faction's land too.

records.text: Enemy camps on the map: finish two or three objectives, no need to clear every enemy.

records.label: Spacetime Rift
records.text: Opens every 3 hours for about 10 minutes and takes you into the rival faction's land, PvP on.

records.label: Daeva Gauge
records.text: Regional Quests, Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds fill the Daeva Gauge. At 100% the last main quest, Daeva Trapped in a Nightmare, opens. It gives the Unique wings Ultimate Daeva Wings and the Unique title Encountering Zikel's Core.

records.name: Nightmare
records.text: Solo boss fights with 10 levels each. Clears pay Phantasmal Fragments for the Nightmare shop.

records.name: Ascension Trial
records.text: A solo, score based run with a weekly rotation and four difficulties. Your score decides the reward.

records.name: Daily Dungeon
records.text: Waves of enemies against the clock. Your score decides the reward; it is the biggest source of Enhance Stones.
